File affected: /app/pyknotid/pyknotid/make/torus.py line 14. This is a Python 3.13 compatibility issue separate from Numpy 2.3.0. Fix required: change `from fractions import gcd` to `from math import gcd`.

Step 21-22: Python 3.13 compatibility fix successful. Changed `from fractions import gcd` to `from math import gcd` in /app/pyknotid/pyknotid/make/torus.py line 14. After fix, all imports work correctly (chelpers, ccomplexity, cinvariants modules successfully imported). The gcd function was moved from fractions to math module in Python 3.9+, making this change necessary for Python 3.13.7 compatibility.
